requirement: Children's products must be tested by a CPSC-accepted third-party laboratory to verify compliance with all applicable children's product safety rules.
requirement_summary: Kids products must be tested by CPSC-accepted third-party lab

evidence_required.description: Test report from CPSC-accepted third-party laboratory confirming compliance with all applicable safety rules

remediation: Submit the product to a CPSC-accepted third-party laboratory for testing against all applicable children's product safety rules per CPSIA Section 14(a)(1).

requirement: Manufacturers or importers of children's products must issue a Children's Product Certificate (CPC) based on third-party test results, certifying that the product complies with all applicable safety rules.
requirement_summary: Must issue CPC based on third-party test results for kids products

evidence_required.description: CPC must reference the test report numbers from third-party testing

remediation: Issue a Children's Product Certificate (CPC) based on third-party test results certifying compliance with all applicable safety rules per CPSIA Section 14(a)(1) & (2).

requirement: Non-sidewalk bicycles shall be road-tested by a rider weighing at least 68.1kg (150 lb) for at least 6.4km (4 mi), including 5 passes over a 30.5m (100 ft) bump course, with no structural, braking, tire failure or loosening of seat, handlebar, controls, or reflectors.
requirement_summary: Non-sidewalk bikes must pass 6.4km road test with 68.1kg rider and 5 bump passes

evidence_required.description: Road test report per §1512.17(a) & §1512.18(p) with test conditions and results

remediation: Conduct road test per §1512.17(a) with a ≥68.1kg rider over ≥6.4km including 5 bump course passes, ensuring no structural or component failures.

requirement: Sidewalk bicycles shall be drop-tested from a height of 300mm (1 ft) onto a paved surface 3 times (with weight), and the wheels, frame, seat, handlebar, and fork shall show no fracture.
requirement_summary: Sidewalk bikes must pass 300mm drop test (3 drops with weight), no fractures

evidence_required.description: Drop test report per §1512.17(b) & §1512.18(q) with test conditions and results

remediation: Conduct 300mm drop test per §1512.17(b) with 3 drops and verify no fractures in wheels, frame, seat, handlebar, or fork.

requirement: The handlebar stem shall withstand a force of 2000 N (450 lbf) for bicycles or 1000 N (225 lbf) for sidewalk bicycles, applied at 45° from the stem centerline in a forward direction at the handlebar attachment point per §1512.18(g). No visible fractures shall result.

evidence_required.description: Handlebar stem strength test report per §1512.6(b) & §1512.18(g)

remediation: Ensure handlebar stem passes strength test at 2000N (regular bicycle) or 1000N (sidewalk bicycle) without failure per §1512.6(b).
